story.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots

draft:
I've been following the development of Gemini Robotics and the latest iteration is a game changer. 
Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots, enabling them to adapt to new situations. 
This technology has significant implications for robotics and AI. 
What are the potential applications of whole body intelligence in robotics?
#AI #Robotics #GeminiRobotics2
